description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#895: pipelined requests are all parsed as they arrive, as in Node 22: each request is emitted at its head, its body is pushed, and the ticks and microtasks run after each piece of body before the next request is parsed, whatever the responses in front of it are doing; the same with chunked bodies and across packets; data after a Connection: close or HTTP/1.0 request in a later packet is HPE_CLOSED_CONNECTION
